"""Single compiled utility proof and four saved-pose references; not engine qualification."""

import hashlib
import sys

P=Path('/tmp/a1-body-kinematic-reference-20260928.py')
b=P.read_bytes()
if hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()!='ae9a96aaf353be398f90a47556e628cb8b968d8556be1f22bc2c59240f451fe4':
    raise RuntimeError('reference definitions changed')
exec(compile(b.decode().split("\nif __name__=='__main__':",1)[0],'<reviewed reference>','exec'),globals())
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve()
DIRECTORY=Path('/tmp/guala-body-projective-geometry.XA8uqHVT')
PARENTS={'FB-01aj-kinematic-reference.json':'18361902ad5b7ba1cb4b64a6d9541782e159ed20e14588b884a36b81b8fcb878'}
EXTRA={
    DIRECTORY/'engine_util_spatial.c':'28fa727f1f2afc3a7434839dbdcb62aff5dd089634d49b7067d712074e3ce0f0',
    DIRECTORY/'wrapper.c':'2fadf63ff6f2f005cdc582beeabd36263bdcd1ce0afded228649523027a57f56',
    Path('native/functional_body/rotation_geometry.patch'):'1e861d76670004d7f4deb471dd753a466f7ca82165108e35ae67a830291aa98c',
}
SCHEMA_OUT='guala.functional-body.projective-rotation-reference.v1'
TARGET_NAME='FB-01aj-projective-rotation-reference.json'


def check_sources():
    check_kinematic_sources()
    for path,sha in EXTRA.items():
        require(hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sha,'candidate changed: '+str(path))


def rotation(q):
    # Independent rational/Decimal reference. Float mode also matches C order.
    if isinstance(q[0],float):
        exponent=math.frexp(max(abs(x) for x in q))[1]
        q=[math.ldexp(x,-exponent) for x in q]
    a,b,c,d=q
    aa,ab,ac,ad=a*a,a*b,a*c,a*d
    bb,bc,bd,cc,cd,dd=b*b,b*c,b*d,c*c,c*d,d*d
    square=aa+bb+cc+dd
    return [[(aa+bb-cc-dd)/square,2*(bc-ad)/square,2*(bd+ac)/square],
            [2*(bc+ad)/square,(aa-bb+cc-dd)/square,2*(cd-ab)/square],
            [2*(bd-ac)/square,2*(cd+ab)/square,(aa-bb-cc+dd)/square]]


def projective_transforms(anatomy, qpos, precision, rotation):
    cast = Decimal.from_float if precision else float
    cv = lambda xs: [cast(float(x)) for x in xs]
    zero, one = cast(0.), cast(1.)
    branches = []

    def dot(a, b):
        return a[0]*b[0]+a[1]*b[1]+a[2]*b[2]

    def norm(q, label):
        square = q[0]*q[0]+q[1]*q[1]+q[2]*q[2]+q[3]*q[3]
        n = square.sqrt() if precision else math.sqrt(square)
        minimum = cast(1e-15)
        mode = 'zero' if n < minimum else 'scale' if abs(n-1) > minimum else 'keep'
        branches.append((label, mode))
        if mode == 'zero':
            return [one, zero, zero, zero]
        if mode == 'scale':
            inv = 1/n
            return [x*inv for x in q]
        return q

    def multiply(a, b):
        return [a[0]*b[0]-a[1]*b[1]-a[2]*b[2]-a[3]*b[3],
                a[0]*b[1]+a[1]*b[0]+a[2]*b[3]-a[3]*b[2],
                a[0]*b[2]-a[1]*b[3]+a[2]*b[0]+a[3]*b[1],
                a[0]*b[3]+a[1]*b[2]-a[2]*b[1]+a[3]*b[0]]

    def matrix(q):
        return rotation(q)

    def rotate(v, q):
        return [dot(row, v) for row in matrix(q)]

    bodies = {0: ([zero]*3, [one, zero, zero, zero], [[one,zero,zero],[zero,one,zero],[zero,zero,one]])}
    values = cv(qpos)
    for body in anatomy['bodies']:
        i, pid, joints = body['id'], body['parent'], body['joints']
        require(body['mocap'] == -1, 'mocap branch absent from this bounded reference')
        if len(joints) == 1 and joints[0]['type'] == 0:
            j = joints[0]['qadr']
            pos, quat = values[j:j+3], norm(values[j+3:j+7], str(i)+':free')
        else:
            pp, pq, pm = bodies[pid]
            pos, quat = cv(body['pos']), cv(body['quat'])
            if pid:
                pos = [dot(row,pos)+pp[k] for k,row in enumerate(pm)]
                quat = multiply(pq,quat)
            for j in joints:
                axis, anchor = rotate(cv(j['axis']),quat), rotate(cv(j['pos']),quat)
                anchor = [anchor[k]+pos[k] for k in range(3)]
                adr, kind = j['qadr'], j['type']
                if kind == 2:
                    displacement = values[adr]-cast(j['qpos0'])
                    pos = [pos[k]+axis[k]*displacement for k in range(3)]
                elif kind in (1,3):
                    if kind == 1:
                        local = norm(values[adr:adr+4], str(i)+':ball:'+str(j['id']))
                    else:
                        angle = values[adr]-cast(j['qpos0'])
                        if angle == 0:
                            local = [one,zero,zero,zero]
                        else:
                            s,c = sincos(angle*cast(.5),precision)
                            local = [c,*(x*s for x in cv(j['axis']))]
                    quat = multiply(quat,local)
                    offset = rotate(cv(j['pos']),quat)
                    pos = [anchor[k]-offset[k] for k in range(3)]
                else:
                    raise RuntimeError('unexpected free/unknown joint within regular body')
        quat = norm(quat,str(i)+':body')
        bodies[i] = pos,quat,matrix(quat)
    geoms = []
    for g in anatomy['geoms']:
        pos,quat,mat = bodies[g['body']]
        sf = g['sameframe']
        require(sf in (0,1,3), 'inertial sameframe branch outside bounded foot reference')
        p = pos.copy() if sf == 1 else [dot(row,cv(g['pos']))+pos[k] for k,row in enumerate(mat)]
        m = matrix(multiply(quat,cv(g['quat']))) if sf == 0 else mat
        geoms.append(dict(pos=p,mat=m,size=cv(g['size'])))
    return dict(pos1=geoms[0]['pos'],pos2=geoms[1]['pos'],mat1=geoms[0]['mat'],mat2=geoms[1]['mat'],
                size1=geoms[0]['size'],size2=geoms[1]['size']), branches



def diagnostic():
    import base64
    import ctypes
    import json
    import subprocess
    import time
    import traceback
    import zlib
    from fractions import Fraction
    from guala_body_joint_boundary import encode
    result=dict(schema=SCHEMA_OUT,completed=False,failure=None,first_failure=None,
        attempts=0,calls=0,rollback_exact=True,evidence_complete=True,
        no_engine_created=True,no_physical_state_changed=True,mounted=False,
        full_body_qualification=False,utility_checks=[],invalid_checks=[],poses=[],
        scope='compiled utility fragment plus archived FK reference; not native force/motion/cold proof')
    started=time.process_time()
    try:
        check_sources()
        library_path=DIRECTORY/'rotation.so'
        require(not library_path.exists(),'fresh library required')
        upstream=Path('/tmp/guala-body-midpoint.igj32n8c/source')
        original=Path('/tmp/guala-body-midpoint.igj32n8c/build/lib/libmujoco.so.3.3.7')
        command=['/usr/bin/cc','-std=c11','-O2','-fPIC','-shared','-fno-fast-math','-ffp-contract=off',
            '-Wl,-Bsymbolic-functions','-I'+str(upstream/'include'),'-I'+str(upstream/'src'),
            str(DIRECTORY/'engine_util_spatial.c'),str(DIRECTORY/'wrapper.c'),str(original),
            '-Wl,-rpath,'+str(original.parent),'-lm','-o',str(library_path)]
        result['build']=dict(command=command,completed=False,
            compiler_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path('/usr/bin/cc').read_bytes()).hexdigest())
        build=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=40)
        result['build'].update(returncode=build.returncode,stdout=build.stdout,stderr=build.stderr)
        require(build.returncode==0,'utility compile failed')
        result['build'].update(completed=True,library_sha256=hashlib.sha256(library_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
        lib=ctypes.CDLL(str(library_path))
        double=ctypes.c_double
        pointer=ctypes.POINTER(double)
        lib.a1_matrix.argtypes=[pointer,pointer];lib.a1_matrix.restype=ctypes.c_int
        lib.a1_vector.argtypes=[pointer,pointer,pointer];lib.a1_vector.restype=ctypes.c_int

        def native_matrix(q):
            values=(double*4)(*q);out=(double*9)(*([123.]*9))
            before=bytes(values)
            record=dict(operation='matrix',quaternion_hex=before.hex(),
                        output_before_hex=bytes(out).hex(),completed=False)
            result['active_native_call']=record
            try:
                record['return_code']=lib.a1_matrix(out,values)
            finally:
                record.update(quaternion_after_hex=bytes(values).hex(),
                              output_after_hex=bytes(out).hex())
            require(record['return_code']==0,'valid matrix refused')
            require(bytes(values)==before,'input quaternion mutated')
            record['completed']=True
            return [list(out)[i:i+3] for i in (0,3,6)]

        def flatten(m):return [x for row in m for x in row]
        def err(a,b):return max(abs(x-y) for x,y in zip(flatten(a),flatten(b)))
        def strings(v):
            return [strings(x) for x in v] if isinstance(v,list) else str(v)

        name,sha=next(iter(PARENTS.items()))
        raw=Path('docs/evidence',name).read_bytes()
        require(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==sha,'parent changed')
        e=json.loads(raw)
        require(e['measurement_recorded'] and e['diagnostic_completed'] and
                e['execution']['exit_code']==0 and not e['execution']['survivors'],'parent incomplete')
        p=e['raw_measurement'];raw=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(p['payload_zlib_base64'],validate=True))
        require(len(raw)==p['raw_bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==p['raw_sha256'],'payload changed')
        data=json.loads(raw)
        require(data['completed'] and len(data['poses'])==4,'four poses required')
        root=next(b for b in data['anatomy']['bodies'] if any(j['type']==0 for j in b['joints']))
        adr=root['joints'][0]['qadr']
        cases=[(label,q) for label,q in (
            ('identity',[1.,0.,0.,0.]),('negative-identity',[-1.,0.,0.,0.]),
            ('axis-x',[0.,1.,0.,0.]),('axis-y',[0.,0.,1.,0.]),('axis-z',[0.,0.,0.,1.]),
            ('minimal-nonzero',[0.,math.ulp(0.),0.,0.]),
            ('mixed-range',[math.ldexp(1.,1023),math.ulp(0.),0.,0.]))]
        base=[1.,.25,-.5,.125]
        for exponent in (-1070,-500,0,500,1020):
            cases.append(('scale-'+str(exponent),[math.ldexp(x,exponent) for x in base]))
        for saved in data['poses']:
            cases.append((saved['label'],saved['qpos'][adr+3:adr+7]))
        epsilon=sys.float_info.epsilon;bound=64*epsilon
        base_matrix=native_matrix(base)
        for label,q in cases:
            row=dict(label=label,q=q,completed=False);result['utility_checks'].append(row)
            actual=native_matrix(q);row['matrix']=actual
            exact=rotation([Fraction.from_float(x) for x in q])
            reference=[[float(x) for x in r] for r in exact]
            identity=[[float(i==j) for j in range(3)] for i in range(3)]
            product=[[sum(actual[i][k]*actual[j][k] for k in range(3)) for j in range(3)] for i in range(3)]
            row.update(component_error=err(actual,reference),orthogonality_error=err(product,identity),
                       sign_invariant=(actual==native_matrix([-x for x in q])),bound=bound)
            require(row['component_error']<=bound and row['orthogonality_error']<=8*bound and row['sign_invariant'],'projective rotation accuracy failed')
            if label.startswith('scale-'):
                row['scale_invariant']=actual==base_matrix
                require(row['scale_invariant'],'binary scale invariance failed')
            v=[.25,-.5,.75];qbuf=(double*4)(*q);vbuf=(double*3)(*v)
            expected=[sum(a*b for a,b in zip(r,v)) for r in actual]
            record=dict(operation='aliased-vector',quaternion_hex=bytes(qbuf).hex(),
                        vector_before_hex=bytes(vbuf).hex(),completed=False)
            row['vector_call']=record;result['active_native_call']=record
            try:
                record['return_code']=lib.a1_vector(vbuf,vbuf,qbuf)
            finally:
                record.update(quaternion_after_hex=bytes(qbuf).hex(),vector_after_hex=bytes(vbuf).hex())
                row['vector']=list(vbuf);row['expected_vector']=expected
            require(record['return_code']==0,'vector refused')
            require(record['quaternion_hex']==record['quaternion_after_hex'],'vector quaternion mutated')
            require(list(vbuf)==expected,'vector law or aliasing differs')
            record['completed']=True
            row['completed']=True

        for label,q in (('zero',[0.]*4),('nan',[float('nan'),0.,0.,0.]),
                        ('infinite',[1.,float('inf'),0.,0.]),('negative-infinite',[1.,0.,-float('inf'),0.])):
            row=dict(label=label,completed=False);result['invalid_checks'].append(row)
            qbuf=(double*4)(*q);out=(double*9)(*([123.]*9));before=bytes(out)
            record=dict(operation='invalid-matrix',quaternion_hex=bytes(qbuf).hex(),
                        output_before_hex=before.hex())
            row['matrix_call']=record;result['active_native_call']=record
            try:
                row['matrix_code']=lib.a1_matrix(out,qbuf);record['return_code']=row['matrix_code']
            finally:
                record.update(quaternion_after_hex=bytes(qbuf).hex(),output_after_hex=bytes(out).hex())
            row['matrix_unchanged']=bytes(out)==before
            vbuf=(double*3)(0.,0.,0.);vout=(double*3)(123.,123.,123.);before=bytes(vout)
            record=dict(operation='invalid-vector',quaternion_hex=bytes(qbuf).hex(),
                        vector_before_hex=bytes(vbuf).hex(),output_before_hex=before.hex())
            row['vector_call']=record;result['active_native_call']=record
            try:
                row['vector_code']=lib.a1_vector(vout,vbuf,qbuf);record['return_code']=row['vector_code']
            finally:
                record.update(quaternion_after_hex=bytes(qbuf).hex(),vector_after_hex=bytes(vbuf).hex(),
                              output_after_hex=bytes(vout).hex())
            row['vector_unchanged']=bytes(vout)==before
            require(row['matrix_call']['quaternion_hex']==row['matrix_call']['quaternion_after_hex'] and
                    row['vector_call']['quaternion_hex']==row['vector_call']['quaternion_after_hex'] and
                    row['vector_call']['vector_before_hex']==row['vector_call']['vector_after_hex'],
                    'invalid call changed its input')
            require(row['matrix_code']==row['vector_code']==1 and row['matrix_unchanged'] and row['vector_unchanged'],'invalid geometry did not refuse atomically')
            row['completed']=True

        for saved in data['poses']:
            row=dict(label=saved['label'],world=[],local=[],controls=[],completed=False);result['poses'].append(row)
            local=saved['qpos'].copy();local[adr:adr+7]=[0.,0.,0.,1.,0.,0.,0.]
            for precision in (0,40,80):
                require(time.process_time()-started<5.,'reference CPU exhausted')
                with localcontext() as context:
                    context.prec=precision or 28
                    control=dict(precision=precision,completed=False);row['controls'].append(control)
                    geom,branches=transforms(data['anatomy'],saved['qpos'],precision)
                    control.update(geometry={k:strings(v) for k,v in geom.items()},branches=branches)
                    value=depth(geom,data['branch'],tuple(data['feature']));control['depth']=str(value)
                    if precision:
                        old=next(x for x in saved['references'] if x['precision']==precision)
                        require(str(value)==old['depth'] and control['geometry']==old['geometry'] and branches==[tuple(x) for x in old['normalization_branches']],'saved decimal control differs')
                    else:
                        require(geom==saved['binary64_replay'] and value==saved['native_depth'],'saved binary64 control differs')
                    control['completed']=True
                    for frame,qpos in (('world',saved['qpos']),('local',local)):
                        record=dict(precision=precision,completed=False);row[frame].append(record)
                        f=native_matrix if not precision else rotation
                        geom,branches=projective_transforms(data['anatomy'],qpos,precision,f)
                        record.update(geometry={k:strings(v) for k,v in geom.items()},branches=branches)
                        value=depth(geom,data['branch'],tuple(data['feature']))
                        record.update(depth=str(value),kept=value<=0,completed=True)
            row['completed']=True
        result['admission']={frame:{str(p):[next(x['kept'] for x in row[frame] if x['precision']==p) for row in result['poses']] for p in (0,40,80)} for frame in ('world','local')}
        result['completed']=True
    except Exception as error:
        result['failure']=dict(type=type(error).__name__,error=str(error),traceback=traceback.format_exc(limit=8))
    finally:
        try:
            check_sources()
            if result.get('build',{}).get('completed'):
                result['library_sha256_after']=hashlib.sha256(library_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                require(result['library_sha256_after']==result['build']['library_sha256'],
                        'compiled utility changed during proof')
        except Exception as error:
            result['source_post_error']=repr(error);result['completed']=False;result['evidence_complete']=False
        result['cpu_seconds']=time.process_time()-started
        if result['cpu_seconds']>=5.:result['completed']=False
    print(json.dumps(encode(result)),flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':
    if sys.argv[1:]==['--child']:
        diagnostic()
    else:
        check_sources()
        try:run_static_fixture()
        finally:check_sources()
